meta.name: redesign-existing-projects
meta.description: Upgrades existing websites and apps to premium quality. Audits current design, identifies generic AI patterns, and applies high-end design standards without breaking functionality. Works with any CSS framework or vanilla CSS.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将现有网站和应用的视觉设计提升至高端品质
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有设计粗糙的网站或应用，想在不破坏功能的前提下提升视觉品质
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade existing websites and apps to premium visual quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a rough-looking site or app and want to elevate its design without breaking functionality

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先扫描整个项目,找出排版、配色、布局、动效等方面的通病(如字体千篇一律、配色刺眼、卡片布局雷同),然后在不推翻原有代码的前提下逐项改进,并补上缺失的加载、空、错误等状态。
howto.when: 当用户把现有网站或应用的代码交给 Claude,并请它升级设计、提升质感时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个网站的设计通病,并逐项改进排版和配色。
say.note: Claude 会扫描项目并列出问题清单再动手改。

say.text: 把项目里千篇一律的三卡片和紫色渐变换成更有层次的布局。
say.note: Claude 会保持现有技术栈,只替换这些通用模式。

say.text: 给这套界面补上按钮悬停、加载骨架和空状态提示。
say.note: Claude 会补全缺失的交互反馈,不重写页面。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project, audits generic AI design patterns (typography, color, layout, components, code), and upgrades them in place without rewriting the stack, adding missing loading, empty, and error states.
howto.when_en: When the user shares an existing website or app and asks Claude to redesign or upgrade its look and quality.

say_en.text: Audit this site for design flaws and improve the typography and colors.
say_en.note: Claude scans the project, lists issues, then fixes them.

say_en.text: Replace the generic three-card row and purple gradient with a layered layout.
say_en.note: It keeps the stack and only swaps the generic patterns.

say_en.text: Add hover, skeleton loading and empty states to this UI, no full rewrite.
say_en.note: It fills in missing feedback states without rewriting pages.
